heading: What the season did not reach

lines.dinner: On the seventh evening a table was laid at Thornwall. You were not at it.
lines.hunt: In Millridge’s hunting grounds, those days, there was no horse of yours.
lines.millridge: The road to Millridge after dark: you did not take it.
lines.thierry: A man keeps the woods here, and you never once met him.
lines.timothy: The man the chancery sent: you never met him face to face.
lines.gregor_none: You never groomed a horse for Gregor.
lines.gregor_some: Two brushes hang in the stable. Gregor only ever let you use one.
lines.marta_word: Martha is still holding a sentence back from you.
lines.elena_late: Elena has something she will only say late at night. You did not wait for that night.
lines.lorenz_never: You never went to the forge-chapel at night.
lines.lorenz_vigil: The forge-chapel was empty whenever you came by night. On one night it was not.
lines.lorenz_closed: The manor’s forge-chapel has a door you never pushed open.
lines.marguerite_word: The lady of Thornwall never needs to raise her voice. There is a sentence of hers you did not wait for.
lines.marguerite_unmet: The lady of Thornwall, whom you never met.
lines.henk_unmet: The baron of Millridge: you only ever heard him spoken of.
lines.ledger_none: You never left a lamp lit in the office at night.
lines.ledger_some: You turned the night ledger for a few evenings and did not come to the end of it.
lines.boundary: Word came from the north woods. You did not walk out along it.
lines.stumps: You looked at the stumps at the edge of the woods and wrote nothing down.
lines.market: On market Saturdays you mostly stayed at the manor.
lines.ledger_followed: On the third day you followed those pages where they led. Someone else would have written a letter about them; someone else would have set them down.
lines.ledger_reported: On the third day you put those pages in a letter to the baron. Someone else would have followed them up; someone else would have set them down.
lines.ledger_deferred: On the third day you set those pages aside until after the harvest. Someone else would have written a letter; someone else would have followed them up.
lines.elena_exposed: On the twelfth day the inspector asked about the receipts. There was an answer that would have kept Elena off that page. You did not give it.
lines.elena_shielded: On the twelfth day the inspector asked about the receipts. There was an answer that would have put Elena on that page. You did not give it.
lines.hunt_night_left: On the twentieth night the fire in the middle of the camp was still burning. You were already on the road back to the manor.
lines.hunt_fire_other: At the fire Henk asked how long you meant to stay. Answer it another way and the faces around that fire would have been different.
